supersedes: GoddessHand.json progression, recharge, tutorial presentation and starter balance; remaining input contract retained

layout.left: One water station, visible on every level; unlocked with equipment at level 4
layout.right: Equipment platform, visible on every level; tools start at level 4
layout.hand_switch: World positions do not mirror when changing holding hand
layout.creek_device: Inactive throughout production New Game. Retained only for editor-only historical equipment fixtures.

shop_lesson.trigger: Level 1 cleared, first magic upgrade not purchased; open shop after 1.8 seconds
shop_lesson.purchase: First magic upgrade costs 75 coins. Safe sheep finish evacuation before opening, ensuring 100 first-level coins.
shop_lesson.gate: Cannot advance until purchase. Guide forces magic page and prevents unrelated weapon/station spending.
shop_lesson.feedback: Gold purchase button and localized instructions; hide guide after successful purchase

magic.recovery_rule: Capacity divided by fill duration. No recharge during casting, paused/menu state or tracking ineligibility; no wall-clock catch-up. Partial charges are usable.

tutorials.palm: Useful fire impact completes lesson; dry firing or missing does not
tutorials.projectile_identity: In-flight water packets retain magic-versus-weapon identity through impact
tutorials.other_actions: Successful weapon fire impact, docking, or actual station supply learns corresponding action
tutorials.lifetime: Learned actions persist through level changes and retries in the expedition; New Game resets them
tutorials.demo: Left fingers point right, right fingers point left. Left remains stationary; right approaches from right and stacks above it.

presentation.ui: Rounded forest-green panels and warm wood edges; preserved colliders; gold first-upgrade feedback
presentation.aim: 18 bounded camera-facing water motes, 72 vertices, no colliders or gameplay authority; 5 mm ground ring
presentation.wind: 10 ribbons: 3 cover player foreground, 7 span forest; original 3.4-unit length and 0.054-unit full width retained
